guidance.verbatim_quote: Net income attributable to Deere & Company for fiscal 2026 is forecasted to be in a range of $4.5 billion to $5.0 billion.
guidance.interpretation: THE central guidance form: Deere guides FY net income in dollars, never quarterly EPS. Maintained at Q2 from the Q1 raise. With H1 FY26 net income of $2.429B (EPS $8.97) already booked, the guide implies H2 FY26 net income of ~$2.07B-$2.57B. At ~270.5M diluted shares, implied H2 EPS ~$7.66-$9.50, split across Q3 and Q4 with Q4 guided to be the stronger quarter.

FY2026 segment outlook row (Deere Segment Outlook for Fiscal 2026): PPA net sales down 5-10% YoY (FY25 base $17,311M -> ~$15.6-16.4B), including +3.0% currency and ~+1.0% price. Price expectation was trimmed ~0.5pt from Q1's ~+1.5%.
SAT FY26 net sales up ~15% (raised from up ~10% at initial Nov guide).
C&F FY26 net sales up ~20% (raised from ~15% at Q1 and ~10% initial).
Financial Services FY2026 net income guided to ~$860M (raised from ~$840M at Q1 and ~$830M initial). H1 FY26 FS net income was $434M, implying ~$426M in H2 (~$213M/qtr).

guidance.interpretation: PPA FY2026 operating-margin outlook 11-13% (vs 15.4% FY25 actual), on net sales down 5-10% from $17,311M. Implies FY26 PPA op profit ~$1.72-2.13B; H1 actual was $845M, so implied H2 PPA op profit ~$0.9-1.3B.

guidance.verbatim_quote: This green bar is labeled with "13.5-15%", indicating a projected operating margin range.
guidance.interpretation: SAT FY2026 operating-margin outlook 13.5-15% (raised from 12.5-14% at initial guide), on FY25 base sales $10,224M.

guidance.verbatim_quote: For FY 2025, there is a gray bar with the value "9.0%".
guidance.interpretation: C&F slide: FY25 margin 9.0%, FY2026 forecast margin '10-12%' (stacked bar), on sales up ~20% from $11,382M base.

guidance.verbatim_quote: we would expect slightly higher revenue in the back half, with the fourth quarter being higher than the third quarter. In addition, we would expect to see our most favorable cost comparisons in the fourth quarter as well.
guidance.interpretation: KEY Q3-specific cadence: H2 FY26 revenue slightly above H1 ($22,981M), with Q4 > Q3. That implies Q3 FY26 total revenue somewhat below half of H2 — roughly $11-11.5B equipment-weighted, and profit skewed to Q4 (best cost comps in Q4).

guidance.verbatim_quote: we expect back half to be higher than the front half, Q4 would be a little bit higher than Q3 overall.
guidance.interpretation: Q&A confirmation of the H2 cadence (file is labeled 'Q3 2026 Earnings Call Transcript' in INDEX but is actually the May 21, 2026 Q2 FY26 Q&A).

guidance.verbatim_quote: We've got more Waterloo large tractor shipments shipping to North America in the back half than the front half of the year. That's abnormal for us, but reflected how the order book built for the course of the year.
guidance.interpretation: Abnormal seasonality flag for PPA: large-tractor shipments are back-half weighted in FY26, and within H2, Q4-weighted ('Q4 a bit stronger than Q3' for large ag). Supports PPA Q3 revenue/profit below Q4 but above normal Q3 troughs.

guidance.verbatim_quote: You'll get a little bit of a step down in Q3 and another step down in Q4, just on a normal seasonal basis. Construction & Forestry, fairly balanced between the two.
guidance.interpretation: SAT declines sequentially in Q3 and again in Q4 (normal seasonality from spring peak); C&F roughly balanced across Q3/Q4 with Q4 slightly stronger.

guidance.verbatim_quote: our direct tariff exposure remains essentially unchanged at approximately $1.2 billion, which is approximately a 3% margin headwind. Net of the refunds, our forecast now includes approximately $900 million of tariff costs for the year.
guidance.interpretation: FY26 guidance embeds ~$900M net tariff cost ($1.2B gross less $272M Q2 IEEPA refund + other). H2 therefore carries substantial tariff cost, but YoY comps ease because tariffs began hitting in H2 FY25 (~$200M in Q3 FY25, ~$300M in Q4 FY25).

guidance.verbatim_quote: our implied net price realization for the equipment operations is between 1.5% and 2% for the year, which is consistent with general inflation levels that we are experiencing, excluding the impact of tariffs.
guidance.interpretation: Equipment-ops FY26 net price +1.5-2%; separately Q&A says price and price/cost improve in the back half as FY25's H2 incentives are lapped.

guidance.verbatim_quote: Price cost will improve as we move through the balance of the fiscal year. Thanks for the question.
guidance.interpretation: Price/cost ratio improves through H2 — favorable for Q3 margins YoY (Q3 FY25 PPA margin was a depressed 13.6%).

guidance.verbatim_quote: The company recorded a recovery of $272 million for refund claims related to IEEPA tariffs which have been filed and accepted by the U.S. Customs and Border Protection.
guidance.interpretation: One-time Q2 FY26 benefit (lifted Q2 equipment margins ~2.5pts per the call). Do NOT extrapolate to Q3; management said only accepted claims were booked and further refunds were not in guidance.

guidance.verbatim_quote: Net income guidance range increased to $4.5 billion - $5.0 billion
guidance.interpretation: Q1 FY26 release headline bullet: guidance raised from the initial $4.00-4.75B after Q1 shipments came in ahead of plan.
